title: File a bug automatically for a red main pipeline
goal: A red pipeline on main that no automatic revert covers becomes one bug item (severity from the failed job: S1 when the gate itself is broken, else S2) the next time a session starts, filed once per pipeline.

gates.question: When does the red-pipeline check call glab: in an async SessionStart hook (no wait, once per pipeline), in the synchronous horizon hook, or only when /kb-sprint runs?
